title: From Refining Capacity to Import Dependence: Reproducible Evidence on Portugal's Diesel and Gasoline Market, 1990-2024

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: School of Media Arts and Design, Polytechnic of Porto

description: This archive contains the reproducible analysis code, derived evidence tables, figures, provenance records, and final report for an empirical study of Portugal's diesel and motor-gasoline balance from 1990 to 2024. The analysis examines how Portugal's petroleum-product system changed around three refining and supply events: the expansion of diesel conversion capability at Sines in 2013, the discontinuation of refining at Matosinhos in May 2021, and the European energy stress episode in 2022. The repository combines Eurostat annual oil-balance data, JODI monthly physical-flow series, DGEG national statistics, European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin prices, and refinery-event metadata. The workflow estimates physical import-dependence ratios, refinery-output coverage, annual structural-break and interrupted-trend diagnostics, monthly segmented event models, Portugal-Spain balance comparisons, source-reconciliation checks, and retail pre-tax price models. Model family for the price arm is selected from stationarity and cointegration diagnostics run on log prices, the scale the models are estimated on, and both products are fitted as two-step Engle-Granger error-correction models. The estimates are unchanged from 0.5.0 and remain the corrected ones: the price sample refitted to the stated 2024 window, and the monthly event models reported both with and without a control for the 2013 hydrocracker, from which the estimates should be read. Estimates published in 0.4.0 are superseded. This release corrects the supporting record rather than the results. The plain-text summary of the report carried figures from before those corrections while stating that they had been verified, and is now corrected and checked against the report. The table-to-source map in the provenance document had drifted and is now generated from the built document. The claim checks skipped year-valued cells, which left break years unverified, and now check them; the readiness and claim gates run in continuous integration rather than only on the author's machine. The release is intended to support transparent review of the report's empirical claims: generated report inputs are checksum-manifested, tables and prose statistics are checked against the evidence bundle, and source disagreements are recorded with sensitivity analyses.
references: Direcao-Geral de Energia e Geologia (DGEG), petroleum-product imports, exports, sales, energy balances, and fuel-price statistics.
Joint Organisations Data Initiative (JODI), Oil World Database, monthly secondary-product supply and demand series.
Eurostat nrg_cb_oil, annual oil supply, transformation, and consumption data.
European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin, weekly consumer fuel prices with and without taxes.
Galp official disclosures, refinery event metadata for Sines and Matosinhos.
notes: Research software and derived-evidence release. Raw downloaded source files are excluded from version control by default where redistribution may be impractical or license-sensitive; the archive includes reproducible acquisition and processing code, provenance records, transformed analysis tables, report inputs, and a checksum manifest for the generated evidence bundle.
